daily_materiality_semantics.candidate_set: exact current I Pareto timetables from one frozen-budget search per route
daily_materiality_semantics.joint_rule: WAIT_ONE_SE and MISMATCH_ONE_SE must both pass
daily_materiality_semantics.mismatch: existing sum of squared fixed-service-share minus daily-demand-share differences
daily_materiality_semantics.one_se_pass: mean paired delta <= standard error + 1e-12; when paired variance is exactly zero, only mean delta <= 0 passes
daily_materiality_semantics.pairing: candidate minus metric-specific reference on the same eligible complete date
daily_materiality_semantics.standard_deviation: sample standard deviation of paired daily differences
daily_materiality_semantics.standard_error: sample_sd / sqrt(n); exactly zero variance gives SE=0
daily_materiality_semantics.wait: existing exact next-departure integration with that date's bucket demand

human_final_route_6.interpretation_limit: Statistical practical equivalence is not causal proof.
